title: Free storage move-out worksheets
label: Moving resources
description: Prepare your notice, collect complete truck quotes and keep a record of your storage exit.
body:
Before you book transport

Start with the facility message template. It asks for the notice deadline and a final amount for each possible moving date, so your comparison starts with confirmed terms.

Compare complete quotes

Use the truck-cost worksheet to include mileage, fuel, taxes and help. Transfer the total to the move-out calculator and compare it against car trips and a later move.

Finish the rental

Take the move-out checklist with you. It includes the final unit check, closure confirmation and the records to keep.

Each resource can be printed or saved as a PDF using your browser. No account or email is required.

title: Storage unit move-out checklist
label: Printable checklist
description: A practical record from checking your notice to confirming that your rental has ended.
body:
This is a planning checklist. Ask your facility which steps it requires and write its answers in the spaces below. Keep account numbers and access codes out of public messages.

Before choosing your last day

  • Check the next unpaid renewal date and monthly charge.
  • Confirm how notice must be given and obtain acknowledgement.
  • Ask for the rental end date and final amount for each moving date.
  • Confirm access hours, vehicle access and any inspection appointment.
  • Confirm where every item will go, including anything requiring disposal.

Notice acknowledged on: ____________________

Confirmed rental end date: ____________________

Final amount and refund timing: ____________________

Before booking the move

  • Measure the largest items and check the route through doors and lifts.
  • Confirm helpers and suitable lifting or loading equipment.
  • Collect complete transport quotes using the truck worksheet.
  • Compare finish dates in the calculator, including the eventual moving cost if you wait.
  • Leave time for cleaning and any required closure steps before access ends.

On the final visit

  • Check the whole unit for remaining belongings and rubbish.
  • Follow the facility's cleaning and lock-removal instructions.
  • Take photographs of the empty unit for your own records where permitted.
  • Complete any required inspection, key return or checkout procedure.
  • Ask for written confirmation of the rental end date and final balance.

After checkout

  • Keep the notice, acknowledgement, final bill and closure confirmation together.
  • Check the final payment and any promised refund against the written amount.
  • Ask the facility to explain any unexpected charge before treating the account as closed.
  • Confirm the status of automatic payments after the final balance is settled.

Closure confirmed by / date: ____________________

Follow-up needed: ______________________________

Use the facility message template to collect the answers before your move.

title: Message your storage facility before moving out
label: Copyable message template
description: Ask for the dates, notice instructions and final amounts needed to compare your moving options.
body:
This message requests information. It does not itself give formal notice. Use the notice method your agreement requires and obtain acknowledgement separately. Replace the bracketed text before sending through your facility's official contact channel.

Subject: Move-out dates and final balance confirmation

Hello,

I am planning to empty my storage unit. I am considering these completion dates: [date A] and [date B].

Before I book transport, please confirm:

1. How much notice is required, how I must give it, and how you will acknowledge it.
2. The earliest rental end date if I give notice on [notice date].
3. The total additional rent and other exit charges if I finish on each date above, including any charge due on the renewal date. Please separate rent, required fees and refunds.
4. Whether any prepaid rent or deposit will be returned, the amount, and the expected timing.
5. Access hours, cleaning, lock or key return, inspection and checkout requirements.
6. How I can obtain written confirmation that the rental has ended and the final balance is settled.

Please let me know if I need to use a separate form or channel to give formal notice.

Thank you,
[Your name]

Turn the reply into calculator inputs

Enter the required notice and the date you actually give it. Use a confirmed additional-rent amount for each option when the facility's billing differs from the calculator's full-month estimate. Put separate mandatory exit charges in the other-exit-charges field.

Do not subtract the same refund twice. If a refund is larger than additional rent, or the reply includes overdue balances or deposits, reconcile those separately using the published method.

If the answer is incomplete

Ask: “For a completed move on [date], what is the total additional amount payable from today until the rental ends, and what refund, if any, is separate from that amount?” Keep the written reply with your notice acknowledgement.

Compare the confirmed costs

title: Rental truck total-cost worksheet
label: Printable quote worksheet
description: Compare two complete moving quotes before entering the transport total in your storage exit plan.
body:
A headline rental rate can cover only part of the move. Ask the provider which charges are included and record each cost once. Use zero for an item confirmed as included, and mark unknown costs with a question mark until you have a complete quote.

Move date: ____________________   Quote date: ____________________

All amounts in US dollars
Cost to confirmQuote AQuote B
Rental for the full time needed________________
Mileage or distance charges________________
Fuel or charging________________
Taxes and booking fees________________
Coverage you choose or must buy________________
Dolly, blankets and other equipment________________
Helpers or loading service________________
Tolls, parking and other move costs________________
Total transport and moving cost________________

Work out mileage and fuel

Count the whole route: pickup location to the unit, every trip to the destination, and the return location. If a quote includes miles, charge only the excess at the quoted rate. For 60 total miles with 30 included and $1 per excess mile, the mileage charge is $30.

For a fuel estimate, divide total miles by an assumed miles-per-gallon value and multiply by your fuel price. For 60 miles at an assumed 10 mpg and $3.50 per gallon, fuel is $21. These are arithmetic examples, not vehicle specifications or current prices. Check the provider's fuel return requirements.

Check the time and cash required

Include loading, traffic, unloading and the return journey when choosing the rental period. Ask what happens if you return late. Confirm any deposit or card hold separately: it can affect the cash you need even when it is not a final cost.

Pickup and return deadlines: ____________________

Deposit or card hold, separate from final cost: ____________________

Unknown charges to resolve: ____________________

Transfer the total once

Put the transport total in the calculator's truck-and-moving-cost field. Enter storage rent and facility exit charges in their separate fields. A cheap quote is useful only if the vehicle, helpers and unit access let you finish on the date you enter.

Compare with car trips and waiting

Print the move-out checklist for the final visit.
